svg.title: Roofer — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as roofer, wearing a work jacket and a hard hat. Visible work cue: Three overlapping roof-tile courses follow a steep slope, with staggered tile joints. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
